title: Revitalizing Acme Corp’s Digital Presence
description: A complete brand refresh and website redesign that increased lead generation by 340% and gave Acme one visual identity across every channel.

content.body:
### Introduction

Acme Corp had outgrown its website. The brand no longer reflected the premium service the team delivers, and new inquiries had stalled. They needed a refresh that would position them as the leader in their region and drive measurable results.

### The challenge

The old site was dated, with inconsistent branding, slow pages and a confusing path to the contact form. Traffic was steady, but conversions had plateaued: the problem was the destination, not the demand.

We needed to rebuild the site from the ground up **without losing the search visibility** Acme had earned over the years.

content.body:
### The approach

We started with a brand workshop to find out what Acme values and what sets it apart. From there we built a visual identity and turned it into a fast site with a simple editor.

The design went through three rounds, with feedback from the team at every stage. Mobile layouts, accessibility and page speed were priorities from day one.

We wrote the copy alongside the design, so every page had a clear message and one obvious next step:

- a headline that names the problem
- proof from real projects
  - numbers first
  - then photos
- one call to action

### The results

> The new site paid for itself in the first quarter.

Leads rose by 340%, pages load 60% faster and visitors read more of the site. Acme now has a web presence that matches the quality of its work. Read how we approach this in [our accessibility guide](/blog/accessibility-guide).
